problem: Agents and chats could satisfy policy-presence tests while still ending material work without durable logging, documentation and learning artifacts.
rootCause: The universal writeback contract was largely validated declaratively. Required CI checked that policy text and skill markers existed, but did not fail a material candidate whose diff omitted the actual Brain learning, activity-ledger and human-documentation closure artifacts.
failedApproach: Relying on AGENTS.md and SKILL.md wording alone.
Testing only that mandatory writeback policy fields and phrases exist.
Waiting until post-merge terminal closure to discover missing writeback artifacts.
Adding an executable regression under an unclassified tests/ path; delivery hygiene correctly rejected it.
fix: Add a deterministic pre-merge material-writeback closure guard to Required CI. A material candidate must include canonical Brain learning, an append-only activity/development-ledger event, and human-readable change/learning documentation in the same diff. Closure-only reconciliation is exempt from recursive self-requirement.
prevention: Every material repository candidate fails closed before lane fan-out when Brain learning is absent.
Every material repository candidate fails closed before lane fan-out when activity/development ledger evidence is absent.
Every material repository candidate fails closed before lane fan-out when human-readable documentation is absent.
Automatic learning-to-skill projection remains mandatory after merge for every Brain learning change.
Every new executable regression path must be classified into a delivery lane in the same candidate.
